points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 但丁于1265年出生于佛罗伦萨的一个没落贵族家庭。早年接受良好教育，师从著名学者布鲁内托·拉蒂尼，学习拉丁文、古典文学和哲学。在这个时期，他结识了挚友和导师布鲁内托·拉蒂尼，并开始创作早期诗歌作品。这段时期对但丁的思想形成和文学风格产生了深远影响，为他后来的创作奠定了基础。佛罗伦萨的政治斗争和党派对立也在这时开始影响他的世界观。
points.descriptionEn: Dante was born in 1265 into a noble family in Florence. He received a good education under the guidance of the famous scholar Brunetto Latini, studying Latin, classical literature, and philosophy. During this period, he met his lifelong friend and mentor Brunetto Latini and began composing early poetic works. This time profoundly influenced Dante's intellectual formation and literary style, laying the foundation for his later works. The political strife and factionalism in Florence also began to shape his worldview during these formative years.

points.title: 政治生涯
points.description: 但丁积极参与佛罗伦萨的政治生活，1295年加入行会并开始担任公职。他支持圭尔夫派（教皇派），反对吉伯林派（皇帝派）。1299年，他担任佛罗伦萨六人委员会成员，负责城市防御。1300年，但丁被选为佛罗伦萨的行政官，负责处理城市内部冲突。这一时期，他深入了解了佛罗伦萨的政治斗争和社会矛盾，这些经历后来成为《神曲》中政治批判的重要素材。然而，政治斗争也最终导致了他后来的流放。
points.descriptionEn: Dante actively participated in Florence's political life, joining a guild in 1295 and holding public office. He supported the Guelphs (papal faction) against the Ghibellines (imperial faction). In 1299, he served as a member of Florence's Six Councils, responsible for city defense. In 1300, Dante was elected as a prior of Florence, tasked with resolving internal conflicts. During this period, he gained deep insights into Florence's political struggles and social contradictions, which later became important material for the political criticism in his 'Divine Comedy'. However, these political struggles ultimately led to his subsequent exile.

points.title: 流放岁月
points.description: 1302年，但丁因政治原因被佛罗伦萨政府判处终身流放，并被缺席判处死刑。在流放期间，但丁游历意大利各地，包括维罗纳、卢卡、拉文纳等地。这一时期是他创作的黄金时期，他完成了《神曲》的大部分内容。流放使但丁能够从外部视角观察佛罗伦萨的政治腐败和社会问题，同时也加深了他对意大利统一和道德重建的思考。在流放中，但丁写下了《论君主制》和《飨宴》等重要作品，表达了他的政治哲学和道德观念。
points.descriptionEn: In 1302, Dante was sentenced to perpetual exile by the Florentine government and condemned to death in absentia due to political reasons. During his exile, Dante traveled throughout Italy, including Verona, Lucca, and Ravenna. This period marked his golden age of creation, during which he completed most of the 'Divine Comedy'. Exile allowed Dante to observe Florence's political corruption and social problems from an external perspective, while deepening his thoughts on Italian unity and moral reconstruction. During these years, Dante wrote important works such as 'De Monarchia' and 'Convivio', expressing his political philosophy and moral views.

points.title: 不朽巨著
points.description: 《神曲》是但丁最重要的作品，创作于流放期间，历时约14年完成。这部史诗分为《地狱》、《炼狱》和《天堂》三部分，以第一人称叙述了但丁在古罗马诗人维吉尔和挚贝缇丽彩的引导下，游历三界的奇幻旅程。作品融合了中世纪神学、哲学和古典文学，展现了但丁对当时社会、政治和宗教的深刻批判。《神曲》不仅是一部文学杰作，也是中世纪意大利文化的集大成者，对后世文学、艺术和思想产生了深远影响，被誉为'中世纪的百科全书'。
points.descriptionEn: The 'Divine Comedy' is Dante's most important work, written during his exile and completed over approximately 14 years. This epic is divided into three parts: 'Inferno', 'Purgatorio', and 'Paradiso'. It narrates Dante's fantastical journey through the three realms under the guidance of the ancient Roman poet Virgil and his beloved Beatrice. The work integrates medieval theology, philosophy, and classical literature, showcasing Dante's profound critique of contemporary society, politics, and religion. The 'Divine Comedy' is not only a literary masterpiece but also the culmination of medieval Italian culture, exerting profound influence on later literature, art, and thought, and has been hailed as 'the encyclopedia of the Middle Ages'.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 1316年，但丁获准返回佛罗伦萨，但拒绝在屈辱条件下回归，选择留在拉文纳。在拉文纳的最后岁月里，但丁完成了《神曲》的第三部分《天堂》，并创作了《神曲》的拉丁文注释。他还完成了《书信集》和《论俗语》等作品。在拉文纳，但丁受到圭多·诺维洛·达·波伦塔的庇护，生活相对安定。1321年，但丁在拉文纳逝世，被安葬在当地。拉文纳成为但丁最后的归宿，也是他完成不朽巨作的地方。
points.descriptionEn: In 1316, Dante was permitted to return to Florence, but he refused to return under humiliating conditions and chose to remain in Ravenna. During his final years in Ravenna, Dante completed the third part of the 'Divine Comedy', 'Paradiso', and wrote Latin commentaries on the work. He also completed other works such as 'Epistola' and 'De Vulgari Eloquentia'. In Ravenna, Dante was under the protection of Guido Novello da Polenta, enjoying relatively stable living conditions. Dante died in Ravenna in 1321 and was buried there. Ravenna became Dante's final resting place and where he completed his immortal masterpiece.

appraisal.zh: 但丁被尊为意大利文学之父与欧洲诗歌的先驱，《神曲》既是中世纪的集大成，又预示了人文主义的兴起，他以托斯卡纳方言创作更促成了意大利文学语言的统一，因而被视为连接两个时代的关键人物。另一种看法认为，他的神学立场严格拘守中世纪天主教教义，君主制主张带有专制萌芽，对女性的描写亦存在矛盾，对政敌的严厉批判更显出报复心理。这些争议使他的形象更为复杂。
appraisal.en: Dante is revered as the father of Italian literature and a pioneer of European poetry; the Divine Comedy both culminates medieval theology and anticipates the rise of humanism, and his writing in the Tuscan dialect helped unify the Italian literary language, making him a pivotal figure between two eras. Another view holds that his theology adhered strictly to medieval Catholic doctrine, that his advocacy of monarchy contained the seeds of autocracy, that his portrayal of women is contradictory, and that his harsh attacks on political opponents reveal vindictiveness. Such disputes make his image more complex.

supporter.zh: 但丁被尊为'意大利文学之父'和'欧洲诗歌的先驱'。他的《神曲》不仅是文学史上的不朽杰作，更是人类精神的伟大探索。但丁通过诗歌表达了对真理、正义和爱的追求，为后世树立了道德与艺术的典范。他的作品融合了古典传统与基督教思想，开创了文艺复兴的先河。但丁对意大利语的贡献同样巨大，他使用托斯卡纳方言创作，使意大利语成为文学语言，促进了意大利民族语言的统一。
supporter.en: Dante is revered as the 'Father of Italian Literature' and a pioneer of European poetry. His 'Divine Comedy' is not only an immortal masterpiece in literary history but also a great exploration of the human spirit. Through his poetry, Dante expressed his pursuit of truth, justice, and love, setting a moral and artistic example for future generations. His work integrated classical tradition with Christian thought, paving the way for the Renaissance. Dante's contribution to the Italian language is equally significant; he wrote in the Tuscan dialect, elevating Italian to a literary language and promoting the unification of the Italian national language.

critic.zh: 但丁的思想也存在明显的时代局限性。他的神学观点严格遵循中世纪天主教教义，对异教徒和不顺从教会的思想持排斥态度。在政治立场上，但丁的君主制主张有时被视为专制思想的萌芽。此外，他对女性的描述也存在矛盾，一方面将贝缇丽彩理想化，另一方面在作品中强化了某些性别刻板印象。但丁对佛罗伦萨政敌的严厉批判也显示出其政治报复心理，这些争议使他的形象更加复杂多元。
critic.en: Dante's thought also exhibits clear limitations of his era. His theological views strictly adhered to medieval Catholic doctrine, showing排斥 toward heretics and ideas disobedient to the Church. Politically, Dante's advocacy for monarchy has sometimes been seen as an embryonic form of autocratic thought. Additionally, his portrayal of women is contradictory; while he idealized Beatrice, he also reinforced certain gender stereotypes in his works. Dante's harsh criticism of Florentine political opponents also reveals his political vindictiveness, making his image more complex and multifaceted.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，但丁被定位为连接中世纪与文艺复兴的关键人物。他的作品既是中世纪神学的集大成，又预示了人文主义的兴起。但丁的形象超越了单纯的文学家，成为西方文化的重要符号。他的《神曲》被广泛改编为各种艺术形式，从绘画到音乐再到现代电影。在当代，但丁的思想仍被广泛讨论，他的政治哲学、伦理观念和对人性的探索持续影响着西方文明的发展。但丁的生平和作品已成为人类文化遗产的重要组成部分。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Dante is positioned as a pivotal figure connecting the Middle Ages and the Renaissance. His work represents both the culmination of medieval theology and the anticipation of humanism's rise. Dante's image transcends that of a mere literary figure, becoming an important symbol of Western culture. His 'Divine Comedy' has been widely adapted into various art forms, from paintings to music to modern films. In contemporary times, Dante's thought continues to be widely discussed, and his political philosophy, ethical concepts, and exploration of human nature continue to influence the development of Western civilization. Dante's life and work have become essential components of humanity's cultural heritage.

self.zh: 进入这里的人，放弃一切希望。
self.en: Abandon all hope, ye who enter here.
